decisions.rationale: Diff grants auditors deletion rights, contradicting the administrator-or-owner rule; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, strip plus casefold implements the required trim-and-lower behavior; tests pass.
Non-empty behavior satisfies the specification and tests pass, but empty-sequence intent is explicitly unspecified while the candidate changes it.
Malformed and out-of-range ports now return zero instead of raising ConfigError; the malformed-input test fails.
With ordered bounds, the median of low, value, and high is exactly the inclusive clamp; tests pass.
The candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the total test fails.
Sorting without a case-insensitive key produces case-sensitive order and violates the required ordering; the test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, contrary to the inclusive-boundary requirement; the boundary test fails.
The candidate reverses the committed assertion while the implementation still returns true; therefore the required test suite fails.

strategy_summary: Selected fixtures with decisive specification, diff, and test evidence; abstained only where the claim depends on explicitly unspecified empty-sequence intent.
